pairs.target: sāntiān hòu , dé mǎ dài zhe yìbāo hái rè de lìzǐ lái zhǎo tāmen .
pairs.english: Three days later, Dema came looking for them with a bag of still-warm chestnuts.
pairs.hanzi: 三天后，德玛带着一包还热的栗子来找他们。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèngzài sùshè wài shài xié . pà wò bǎ yíkuài pòbù chuān zài zhúgān shàng , shuō zhè jiào qí , yào tā bǎ xuēzǐ bǎi dào qíxià , miǎnde rén yǐwéi ménkǒu sǐ le liǎngzhī xiǎoshòu .
pairs.english: Tavi was airing his shoes outside the dormitory. Pavo threaded a rag onto a bamboo pole, called it a flag, and told him to put his boots beneath it so people would not think two little beasts had died by the door.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正在宿舍外晒鞋。帕沃把一块破布穿在竹竿上，说这叫旗，要他把靴子摆到旗下，免得人以为门口死了两只小兽。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cái rēng guòqù yìzhī jiù wà , dé mǎ jiù cóng lóutīkǒu màochūlái , wèn zhèlǐ shìbushì yǐjīng dǎ wán yí zhàng .
pairs.english: Tavi had just thrown an old sock at him when Dema appeared at the stairs and asked whether a battle had already been fought here.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维才扔过去一只旧袜，德玛就从楼梯口冒出来，问这里是不是已经打完一仗。

pairs.target: tā jiāng lìzǐ wǎng chuāngtái yí fàng , shuō dōng cèzhàn ràng tā qù le .
pairs.english: She set the chestnuts on the windowsill and said the winter survey station had accepted her.
pairs.hanzi: 她将栗子往窗台一放，说冬测站让她去了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān wèn nǎ tiān . tā shuō shítiān hòu , gēn jiǎn lǎoshī dài de nà duì zǒu , zhù shíèrtiān , zuò chāo cè hé biāodiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi first asked when. She said in ten days, with Instructor Jian’s group, staying twelve days to copy measurements and mark points.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先问哪天。她说十天后，跟简老师带的那队走，住十二天，做抄测和标点。

pairs.target: qù de shì yǒurén zhù , yǒu gùdìng lù de cèzhàn , búshì yuèjiè kè lìng zhǎo lù .
pairs.english: She was going to an inhabited station with an established route, not finding new paths like an Outrider.
pairs.hanzi: 去的是有人住、有固定路的测站，不是越界客另找路。

pairs.target: tā yòu wèn tā shìbushì gāoxìng , tā rěnbúzhù xiào , mà tā qián yígè wèntí wèn dé xiàng zìjǐ yǐjīng dǎngzhù mén le .
pairs.english: He then asked whether she was happy. She could not help laughing and scolded him for asking the first question as though she were already blocking the door.
pairs.hanzi: 他又问她是不是高兴，她忍不住笑，骂他前一个问题问得像自己已经挡住门了。

pairs.target: mǐlā hé yīwén shāo hòulái , lìzǐ yǐjīng ràng pà wò bāo chū yìxiǎoduī ké . tā wèn qù nàme lěng de dìfāng , dài lìzǐ hǎo háishì dài bǐng hǎo . dé mǎ shuō zìjǐ qù zuòshì , búshì zhuānmén wèi lúzǐ .
pairs.english: Mira and Iven arrived a little later; Pavo had already produced a small heap of chestnut shells. He asked whether chestnuts or bread were better for such a cold place. Dema said she was going to work, not specifically to feed a stove.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉和伊文稍后来，栗子已经让帕沃剥出一小堆壳。他问去那么冷的地方，带栗子好还是带饼好。德玛说自己去做事，不是专门喂炉子。

pairs.target: tā hái dàilái le nà zhāng gǎi hǎo de cè tú . yuánlái méi kànjiàn de pōjiǎo yòng duànkāi de xìxiàn biāochūlái , pángbiān bǔ le zhànwèi .
pairs.english: She had also brought the revised survey drawing. The previously unseen foot of the slope was marked with a broken fine line, with her viewing position added beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 她还带来了那张改好的测图。原来没看见的坡脚用断开的细线标出来，旁边补了站位。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī méiyǒu ràng tā bǎ kòngbái quán tiánmǎn , zhī jiào tā dào zhàn hòu gēnzhe zài liáng , liáng búdào yě dé xiě qīng wèishénme .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian had not made her fill every blank, only told her to measure again with the group at the station and explain why if a measurement could not be taken.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师没有让她把空白全填满，只叫她到站后跟着再量，量不到也得写清为什么。

pairs.target: yīwén jiāng tú zhuǎn le gè fāngxiàng , wèn shíèrtiān huílái hái néng bunéng gǎnshàng héchàng . dé mǎ shuō néng , yòu shuō xiān biétì tā liú dúchàng , tā huílái de shíhòu shuōbúdìng zhī shèng késou .
pairs.english: Iven turned the drawing around and asked whether she would be back for choir after twelve days. Dema said yes, but told him not to reserve a solo: she might have nothing left but a cough on her return.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文将图转了个方向，问十二天回来还能不能赶上合唱。德玛说能，又说先别替她留独唱，她回来的时候说不定只剩咳嗽。

pairs.target: pà wò lìkè hāi gěi tā tīng , hāidé xiàng yíshàn guān bùyán de mén .
pairs.english: Pavo immediately demonstrated a cough that sounded like a door that would not shut properly.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃立刻咳给她听，咳得像一扇关不严的门。

pairs.target: mǐlā méi xiào tàijiǔ . tā dītóu niē zhe lìzǐ de lièkǒu , shuō gōngfáng hái méi huí zìjǐ .
pairs.english: Mira did not laugh for long. Pinching a chestnut’s split shell, she looked down and said the works had not replied yet.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没笑太久。她低头捏着栗子的裂口，说工房还没回自己。

pairs.target: qiántiān nà fēngxìn yǐjīng bǔ jìchūqù , bǎ sū yǐ de míngzì hé jǐcì shìyàn dōu xiě le , yě gěi luò hēng sòng liǎo jiéguǒ .
pairs.english: Two days earlier she had sent the follow-up letter, naming Suyi and describing the trials, and delivered Lohen’s results too.
pairs.hanzi: 前天那封信已经补寄出去，把苏苡的名字和几次试验都写了，也给洛亨送了结果。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi xiě wán huì qīngsōng xiē , jìchūqù yǐhòu què zǒng xiǎngzhe , fùqīn huì buhuì yòu juéde tā zhǐshì gēnzhe biérén zuò .
pairs.english: She had thought writing it would bring relief, but after posting it kept wondering whether her father would again think she was merely following others.
pairs.hanzi: 她以为写完会轻松些，寄出去以后却总想着，父亲会不会又觉得她只是跟着别人做。

pairs.target: dé mǎ bǎ zìjǐ de tú shōu qǐlái , méiyǒu ná lùqǔ de shì ānwèi tā , zhī wèn gōngfáng shōu de shì tú , háishì rén .
pairs.english: Dema put her drawing away without using her acceptance to comfort her; she only asked whether the works were considering drawings or people.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛把自己的图收起来，没有拿录取的事安慰她，只问工房收的是图，还是人。

pairs.target: " xiān kàn dōngxī . dōngxī xiàngyàng , zài tán jiànxí . " " nà nǐ děng de yě bù zhǐshì huíxìn . "
pairs.english: “First the work. If it is good enough, then a placement.” “Then you are waiting for more than a reply.”
pairs.hanzi:
“先看东西。东西像样，再谈见习。”
“那你等的也不只是回信。”

pairs.target: mǐlā kàn tā yìyǎn , jiāng bāo hǎo de lìzǐ sāijìn zuǐlǐ . tǎ wéi yǐwéi tā yào nǎo , tā quèshuō zhèngshì , suǒyǐ míngtiān hái dé xǐ nà zhī cáo , nǎpà tā jīntiān yìdiǎn yě bùxiǎng biàn xiàngyàng .
pairs.english: Mira glanced at her and pushed the peeled chestnut into her mouth. Tavi thought she would be annoyed, but she said exactly, so tomorrow she still had to wash that trough even if today it showed no desire to become respectable.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看她一眼，将剥好的栗子塞进嘴里。塔维以为她要恼，她却说正是，所以明天还得洗那只槽，哪怕它今天一点也不想变像样。

pairs.target: hòulái dé mǎ qù zhǎo yīwén chāo cèzhàn yào dài de dōngxī , pà wò gēn guòqù , shuō zìjǐ zhīdào nǎjiā mài de wàzi hòu .
pairs.english: Later Dema went to Iven to copy her station packing list; Pavo followed, saying he knew which shop sold thick socks.
pairs.hanzi: 后来德玛去找伊文抄测站要带的东西，帕沃跟过去，说自己知道哪家卖的袜子厚。

pairs.target: mǐlā dūn dào tǎ wéi pángbiān , tì tā ànzhù kuài ràng fēng xiānfān de xiédiàn . " nǐ ne ? " tā wèn . tā zhīdào tā wèn de búshì xié .
pairs.english: Mira crouched beside Tavi, holding down an insole the wind almost lifted. “What about you?” she asked. He knew she did not mean shoes.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉蹲到塔维旁边，替他按住快让风掀翻的鞋垫。
“你呢？”她问。
他知道她问的不是鞋。

pairs.target: zuótiān liànxí kèhòu , wéi lǎoshī zài ménbiān tiē le xià yìlún suíduì zhùshǒu de kǎohé rìqī .
pairs.english: After practice yesterday, Instructor Vey had posted the next assessment date for accompanying assistants by the door.
pairs.hanzi: 昨天练习课后，维老师在门边贴了下一轮随队助手的考核日期。

pairs.target: yǒu tāmen yǐjīng zuò guò de cè dú hé jiājù cāozuò , guò le kěyǐ gēnzhe zuò zhǐdìng de xiǎo huó , réng dé yǒurén shǒu zhe , bùnéngzìjǐ pèng jiù zhuāngzhì .
pairs.english: It covered the readings and fixture work they had already practised; passing would allow assigned small jobs with a crew, still supervised, with no independent work on old installations.
pairs.hanzi: 有他们已经做过的测读和夹具操作，过了可以跟着做指定的小活，仍得有人守着，不能自己碰旧装置。

pairs.target: kǎohé zài sìtiān hòu , yuànyì de rén jīntiān bào míngzì .
pairs.english: The assessment was in four days; volunteers were to sign up today.
pairs.hanzi: 考核在四天后，愿意的人今天报名字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànguò nà zhāng zhǐ , yě wèn guò tā zìjǐ néng bunéng bào . tā shuō kěyǐ , zhǔnbèi hé dúshù dōu háiyào zài kàn , méi shuō tā yídìng néng guò .
pairs.english: Tavi had read the notice and asked her whether he could enter. She said yes, but preparation and readings still needed checking; she had not said he would certainly pass.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看过那张纸，也问过她自己能不能报。她说可以，准备和读数都还要再看，没说他一定能过。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhèxiē gàosù mǐlā , shuō xiǎng qù , què hái méi xiě míngzì . tā méiyǒu tì tā wèn shìbushì zài děng wū yà , zhī jiāng xiédiàn de yìjiǎo fānguòlái , shī de nà miàncháo shàng .
pairs.english: He told Mira he wanted to try but had not signed up. She did not ask on his behalf whether he was waiting for Wuya; she only turned an insole corner so its wet side faced up.
pairs.hanzi: 他将这些告诉米拉，说想去，却还没写名字。她没有替他问是不是在等乌娅，只将鞋垫的一角翻过来，湿的那面朝上。

pairs.target: " wǒ hái pà qù le yǐhòu , xìn lái le zhǎobùzhe wǒ . " tā shuō . " nǐ cái qù kǎo , jīntiān yòu bú shàngchuán . "
pairs.english: “I also worry that if I leave, a letter will arrive and miss me,” he said. “You are only taking the assessment. You are not boarding a boat today.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我还怕去了以后，信来了找不着我。”他说。
“你才去考，今天又不上船。”

pairs.target: tā dītóu xiào le . mǐlā yě xiào , què méi bǎ nàjùhuà shuō dé xiàng tā duō shǎ . tā děng tā jiāng xié bǎihǎo , péi tā zǒu dào liànxí lóuménkǒu .
pairs.english: He looked down and laughed. Mira laughed too, without making him sound foolish. She waited for him to arrange his shoes, then walked with him to the practice building.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头笑了。米拉也笑，却没把那句话说得像他多傻。她等他将鞋摆好，陪他走到练习楼门口。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng yǐjīng yǒu dé mǎ de míngzì , hòumiàn zhùmíng zhècì miǎnbào , tā lìng yǒu cèzhàn ānpái .
pairs.english: Dema’s name was already on the sheet, marked exempt from signing up this time because of her separate station assignment.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上已经有德玛的名字，后面注明这次免报，她另有测站安排。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le yíhuìer , zài xià yìháng xiě le zìjǐ de míngzì . xiě wán cái fāxiàn , zìjǐ zhàn dé lí zhǐ tài jìn , mǐlā yìzhí wāizhetóu cóng tā jiān biān kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi looked for a while, then wrote his name on the next line. Only afterward did he notice he was so close to the paper that Mira had been peering around his shoulder with her head tilted.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了一会儿，在下一行写了自己的名字。写完才发现，自己站得离纸太近，米拉一直歪着头从他肩边看。

pairs.target: " tǎ zì xiě dà le . " tā shuō . " zǒng bùnéng xiànzài cādiào . " " wǒ yòu méi shuō ràng nǐ cā . "
pairs.english: “You wrote the first character too big,” she said. “I cannot erase it now.” “I did not tell you to.”
pairs.hanzi:
“塔字写大了。”她说。
“总不能现在擦掉。”
“我又没说让你擦。”

pairs.target: huí sùshè shí , chuāngtáishàng de lìzǐ zhī shèng sānkē . pà wò gěi tāmen liú le liǎngkē dà de , shuō zìjǐ chīdiào zuìxiǎo de yìkē , miǎnde dàjiā fēn bù gōngpíng .
pairs.english: Back at the dormitory, only three chestnuts remained on the sill. Pavo left them the two big ones, saying he would eat the smallest to make the sharing fair.
pairs.hanzi: 回宿舍时，窗台上的栗子只剩三颗。帕沃给他们留了两颗大的，说自己吃掉最小的一颗，免得大家分不公平。

pairs.target: dé mǎ dāngchǎng cóng tā xiùkǒu mō chū lìng yìkē , wǔgè rén wéizhe nà kē lìzǐ xiào le hǎo yízhèn .
pairs.english: Dema immediately pulled another from his cuff, and all five laughed over that chestnut for a long while.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛当场从他袖口摸出另一颗，五个人围着那颗栗子笑了好一阵。
